recommendation: Keep this audit as-is for core. If legacy Observation genetics CIGAR guidance is still needed, it belongs in legacy publication context or an external genomics guide rather than current core source.
issue_request: FHIR-8085 was a Published/Persuasive Clinical Genomics change request for the old Observation genetics CIGAR extension, asking that observed nucleotides differing from the reference be uppercase and nucleotides matching the reference be lowercase, while alignment was represented by CIGAR and ObservedAllele/referenceAllele remained plain ATCG sequences.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly names FHIR-8085. Historical Observation genetics source did contain CIGAR, ObservedAllele, and ReferenceAllele artifacts; the nearest source history shows old case-sensitive CIGAR wording in genetics spreadsheets and examples, but those artifacts were later retired and removed from active core source.
additional_context: Observation remains an active current resource, but active source has no geneticsCIGAR, geneticsObservedAllele, geneticsReferenceAllele, or related Observation genetics profile source to edit. Commit 3cfe12f removed outdated clinical genomics Observation artifacts from core, and the Jira comments record that the extension was removed in R5. The FHIR Extension Pack retains a few retired Observation genetics extensions with a replacement note pointing to the Genomics Reporting Guide, but it has no geneticsCIGAR definition. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community record.
reconciliation: Created an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. Reintroducing or editing the retired CIGAR extension would not affect the current FHIR core build, and editing checked-in historical snapshots would not be a current-spec fix.
